notes.title: Japanese Localization Added!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are excited to announce that with the great help of a player 望入世, we've now added Japanese localization for the whole game! We are very excited to see more players be able to enjoy the game with this new update :)

Other Fixes:
[list]
[*] Updated the Settings menu (Made font consistent across settings text, took off font and voice volume)
[*] Reduced the file size of the credits cutscene & therefore reducing build size
[*] Fixed an issue with Traditional Chinese Localization where choosing to talk to Mushroom about your feelings will lead to text incorrectly displayed in English
[*] Fixed an issue with Traditional Chinese version where the [2 years later] and [10 years later] time skip countdown UI wouldn't display correctly
[/list]

We also want to share with you a couple of comic drabbles we drew as a crossover between Zero-Sum Heart and our previous game Death Trick: Double Blind:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040836/a4c52f295acc3ba51acd50ed84a634f06b62707a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040836/fb473c3e103860ee781ec86cfde5f651c6091cb0.png[/img]

You can find these games together in this little bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46209/From_the_same_creators/

notes.title: 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for playing Zero-Sum Heart! Here's a quick patch-- If you encounter any more bugs, you can reply to the bug report thread in the forum, or message us through Discord.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players get stuck on certain mid-game ending pages
[*] Fixed a bug where in the [spoiler]Water Under the Bridge[/spoiler] ending, the protagonist sprites have a display error: [spoiler]Her hair should be white, not blue.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a bug where during [spoiler]Ritual reversal[/spoiler], The Witch [spoiler]mistakenly tells you you've killer Bear, even if you hadn't[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed a few typos and rogue punctuation marks.
[/list]
